input.quote: The Parties recognize and agree that the PG does not make any representations or warranties, including, but not limited to, any representation or warranty regarding:
input.rationale: The only warranty-related language in the Agreement is the disclaimer at Subparagraphs 4.9-4.10 (p0126-p0127): the PG makes no representations or warranties as to Supplier performance, Wet Segment performance or reliability, or integration, and \"nothing in this Agreement shall be construed as such a warranty or guarantee\". No express performance warranty, warranty period or warranty remedy runs to us anywhere (searches for warrant/guarantee/defect/workmanlike/refund-as-remedy return nothing else), and the Supply Contract warranties are not passed through - Paragraph 4.8 only lets the PG elect to exercise Supply Contract remedies. That is the walk-away position (all warranties disclaimed, no conformance warranty), so we redline. Direction: the PG comprises representatives of each Initial Party, including Teleglobe, so the 4.9 disclaimer protects us and we have not disturbed it; the warranty we insert binds only the Terminal Parties (Teleglobe is not one), who provide Segment T and perform the operation and maintenance duties we fund through Capital Costs and O&M Costs. We target the fallback: 90 days conformance for Segment T and its software against the Annex 8 facilities, functions and documentation, 30 days for O&M duties, with repair, replacement or refund. We have not added the preferred 12-month software period, compliance-with-laws or malicious-code warranties, which remain available as a further ask.

proposal.summary: Insert a fallback-level Terminal Party performance warranty (90 days Segment T/software conformance, 30 days O&M duties) with repair, replacement or refund remedies.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement gives us no performance warranty at all and Subparagraph 4.9 disclaims warranties, which is our walk-away position. We added a fallback-level warranty from the Terminal Parties (90 days for Segment T and its software against Annex 8, 30 days for their operation and maintenance duties) with repair, replacement, re-performance or refund as the remedy, leaving the PG disclaimer untouched.

ops.text: 4.10 Each Terminal Party warrants to the other Parties that (i) for a period of ninety (90) days following the RFS Date, its Segment T, including any software incorporated in it, will conform in all material respects to the facilities, functions and documentation specified for it in Annex 8; and (ii) for a period of thirty (30) days following performance, the operation and maintenance duties it performs under Paragraph 10 will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner. For breach of these warranties, the responsible Terminal Party shall promptly repair or replace the non-conforming Segment T or re-perform the non-conforming duties or, if it does not do so within a reasonable period, refund the amounts paid by the Parties in respect of the non-conforming Segment T or duties.

mappings.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
